scripts.check:bundle: expo export --platform ios --output-dir dist/bundle-check-ios && expo export --platform web --output-dir dist/bundle-check-web
scripts.review-questions: tsc scripts/review-questions.ts src/content/review.ts src/engine/types.ts --outDir .review-build --module commonjs --target es2020 --esModuleInterop --resolveJsonModule --skipLibCheck --strict false --ignoreConfig && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('src/content/series.json','.review-build/src/content/series.json'); if (fs.existsSync('src/content/series.en.json')) fs.copyFileSync('src/content/series.en.json','.review-build/src/content/series.en.json');" && node .review-build/scripts/review-questions.js
scripts.translate-questions: tsc scripts/translate-questions.ts src/content/translate.ts src/engine/types.ts --outDir .translate-build --module commonjs --target es2020 --esModuleInterop --resolveJsonModule --skipLibCheck --strict false --ignoreConfig --types node && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('src/content/series.json','.translate-build/src/content/series.json')" && node .translate-build/scripts/translate-questions.js
